en.headline: Four stray dogs tear bumper from parked car in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Video circulating online showed a yellow dog wrenching off part of a white private car's front bumper outside Fu Shing Street before officers arrived and the animals fled.
body: Four unattended dogs damaged a parked private car in Tuen Mun in the early hours of Wednesday, tearing off part of its front bumper, police and circulating video showed.

A resident reported the incident at about 3.31am near 18 Fu Shing Street. Officers arrived roughly ten minutes later and found scratches on the bodywork and the front bumper damaged. The dogs moved away as the patrol car approached.

Video shared online captured one yellow dog repeatedly biting and pulling the bumper while another climbed onto the bonnet. Police classified the case as a stray-animal matter, contacted the owner and made no arrests.
The episode comes amid heightened public attention to unattended dogs in the New Territories following recent fatal attacks elsewhere in the region.

zh.headline: 屯門四流浪狗扯斷私家車車頭泵把
zh.dek: 網上片段顯示黃狗用力拉扯白色私家車車頭泵把，另有狗隻擂上車頭；警方凌晨接報後列作流浪動物處理。
body: 屯門富盛街周三凌晨發生流浪狗破壞私家車事件，四隻無人看管的狗隻包圍一輛停泊的白色私家車，其中一隻黃狗用力咬住並扯斷車頭泵把一角。
警方約凌晨3時31分接獲一名女子報案，指富盛街18號對開有私家車被狗破壞。警員約10分鐘後到場，發現車身有刮痕、車頭泵把損毀，狗隻隨即離開。
網上片段顯示黃狗反復拉扯泵把，另一隻狗半個身擂上車頭。警方已聯絡車主跟進，案件列作流浪動物處理，暫無人被捕或受傷。
事件發生之際，新界多區對無人看管狗隻的關注正因近期致命襲擊事件而升高。
